messages:
Sam (PS): FYI Acme's POC hit a bunch of 429s during their load run just now. They ramped to ~110 req/s for 45s, then got Retry-After: 15 responses.
Maria (AE): Ugh. Which endpoint exactly? streaming chat or ordinary completions?
Sam (PS): Streaming chat + some small prompt bursts. Logs show lots of short-lived requests ~20000ms each.
Alex (Eng): Likely the per-route burst cap. Their tenant is on default route caps, so bursts get throttled when the burst window fills.
Jen (Support): Opened ticket SUP-4392. Asked for logs and the exact timestamps. Also asked them to add exponential backoff with jitter immediately.
Sam (PS): They need to run another scheduled test tomorrow for the demo. Any short-term remedies we can do?
Alex (Eng): Options (short-lived):
- Temporarily increase the tenant's burst_tokens for route `chat.streaming` (e.g., 60 -> 240)
- Add a temporary per-tenant per-route override so only Acme gets higher burst
- Put a soft daily token budget (notify at 70/90%, hard stop at 600k tokens)
I can push an override if infra signs off.
Maria (AE): They asked about cost impact if we lift caps. Can we give them an estimate tied to token budget?
Alex (Eng): Yes, we can simulate cost based on their average tokens per request. Jen, can you produce a 48h cost projection for a 200 req/s 30m run?
Jen (Support): On it. Also suggested client changes: add an `X-Customer-Run-Id` header and include a small random delay on start to avoid synchronized bursts.
RatecapBot: Tenant acme: detected spike at 14:02:13 UTC, window utilization 92%. Recommendation: stagger requests and enable per-route override if demo requires sustained bursts.
Sam (PS): If infra approves the 48h override, I will notify the customer and require them to keep the soft budget and alerts enabled.
Alex (Eng): For transparency, here's the admin curl to change limits (internal only):
```
curl -X POST \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/acme/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"chat.streaming","burst_tokens":240,"daily_budget_tokens":500000}'
```
Maria (AE): Sounds good. I'll ask them to reduce concurrency on their side as a fallback and confirm the test window.
Jen (Support): SUP-4392 updated with proposed limits, estimated cost delta, and copy of admin API call. Waiting on infra approval.
Sam (PS): Thanks everyone. I'll loop the customer in after infra responds. Please ping here once approved so I can lock in the demo slot. :pray:
